title: A big sapphire bombed out of the rock
description: The player picks up a pair of spectacles in a cave of bricks, and a big sapphire buried in the floor ahead shows through them. He sets a bomb on the floor above it and runs back; the explosion breaks the floor, and he drops into the hole and collects the sapphire.
